rows.ja: 当社は、2024年１月に国土交通省から要請があった「型式指定申請における不正行為の有無等に係る実態調査」に 基づき、調査対象期間(*1)におけるすべての型式指定申請2,403試験を対象に調査を行いました。調査の結果、２つ の試験項目について、計５試験で不正があったことを確認し、2024年５月30日に同省に報告いたしました。
rows.reference_en: Under the request issued in January 2024 by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism to conduct an "Investigation of facts regarding the existence of irregularities in Applications for Type Designation," the Company investigated all of its 2,403 tests for applications for Type Designation, implemented in the period covered by this investigation*1. The investigation results confirmed irregularities in a total of five tests in two test categories, which was reported to the Ministry on May 30, 2024.
rows.yakulingo_en: Based on the "Investigation into the Existence of Misconduct, etc. in Type Designation Applications" requested by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism in 2024/１, the Company conducted an investigation covering all 2,403 tests related to type designation applications during the investigation period (*1). As a result of the investigation, it was confirmed that misconduct had occurred in a total of ５ tests involving ２ test items, and the Company reported this to the Ministry on 2024/５/30.
rows.smartcat_en: In 2024/1, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism requested the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (MLIT) to conduct a survey on all type designation application tests in the survey period (*1) (2,403). As a result of the investigation, we confirmed that there was fraud in a total of 2 test items in 5 tests, and reported it to the Ministry in 2024/5.30.
rows.deepl_en: In response to a request from the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism in January 2024 to conduct a “fact-finding investigation into the presence of misconduct in type approval applications,” the Company conducted an investigation covering all 2,403 tests related to type approval applications during the investigation period (*1). As a result of the investigation, the Company confirmed that misconduct had occurred in a total of five tests across two test items and reported this to the Ministry on May 30, 2024.
rows.nani_en: Based on the fact-finding survey regarding the presence or absence of irregularities in model designation applications requested by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism in January 2024, the company investigated all 2,403 model designation application tests during the survey target period (*1). As a result of the investigation, the company confirmed irregularities in a total of 5 tests across 2 test items and reported them to the Ministry on May 30, 2024.
rows.llm_en: In line with the "Fact-Finding Investigation on the Presence of Misconduct in Applications for Type Designation" requested by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism in January 2024, the Company investigated all 2,403 tests conducted for applications for type designation during the period subject to the investigation (*1). As a result of the investigation, the Company confirmed misconduct in a total of five tests relating to two test items, and reported this to the Ministry on May 30, 2024.

rows.ja: 当連結会計年度のグローバル販売台数は、米国・メキシコ市場の年間販売台数が過去最高を更新するなど、北米市場での販売が好調に推移したことから、前期比5.0％増の1,303千台となりました。
rows.reference_en: Global sales volume for the fiscal year was 1,303 thousand units, up 5.0% year on year. This was driven by  strong performance in the North American market, with the United States and Mexico recording their highest ever  annual sales volumes.
rows.yakulingo_en: Global sales volume for the current consolidated fiscal year increased by 5.0% from the previous fiscal year to 1,303 k units, as sales in the North American market performed strongly, including record-high annual sales volumes in the U.S. and Mexican markets.
rows.smartcat_en: In the consolidated fiscal year under review, global sales increased 5.0% year on year to 1,303 thousand units, reflecting strong sales in the North American market, including record-breaking annual sales in the U.S. and Mexico markets.
rows.deepl_en: Global sales volume for the current consolidated fiscal year increased by 5.0% year-over-year to 1,303,000 units, driven by strong sales in the North American market, where annual sales in the U.S. and Mexican markets reached record highs.
rows.nani_en: Global sales volume for the current consolidated fiscal year increased by 5.0% year-on-year to 1,303 thousand units, driven by strong sales in the North American market, including record-breaking annual sales in the US and Mexico markets.
rows.llm_en: Global sales volume for the fiscal year under review increased 5.0% year on year to 1,303 thousand units, as sales in the North American market were strong, with annual sales volumes in the U.S. and Mexican markets setting new records.

rows.ja: 去最高の販売台数となりました。北米全体でも、カナダやメキシコの好調な販売により、前期比20.0％増の617千台となりました。
rows.reference_en: America as a whole was also strong, with a 20.0% year-on-year growth in sales to 617 thousand units, thanks to robust sales in both Canada and Mexico.
rows.yakulingo_en: This represented the highest sales volume on record. Across North America as a whole, sales increased by 20.0% from the previous fiscal year to 617 k units, driven by strong sales in Canada and Mexico.
rows.smartcat_en: This was the highest sales volume since the end of the fiscal year. In North America as a whole, sales in Canada and Mexico increased 20.0% year on year to 617 thousand units.
rows.deepl_en: This marked the highest sales volume on record. In North America as a whole, sales rose 20.0% year-over-year to 617,000 units, driven by strong sales in Canada and Mexico.
rows.nani_en: It became the highest sales volume ever. Overall North America also saw a 20.0% increase year-on-year to 617 thousand units, driven by strong sales in Canada and Mexico.
rows.llm_en: a record sales volume. In North America as a whole, sales rose 20.0% year on year to 617 thousand units, supported by strong sales in Canada and Mexico.

rows.ja: 「MAZDA CX-30」や「MAZDA2 Hybrid」の販売は増加したものの、「CX-60」や「CX-5」及び「MAZDA6」等の販売減少により、前期比3.4％減の174千台となりました。
rows.reference_en: While sales of the CX-30 and Mazda2 Hybrid model increased, overall sales in Europe declined 3.4% from the previous year to 174 thousand units mainly due to the decrease in sales of the CX-60, CX-5 and Mazda6.
rows.yakulingo_en: Although sales of the "MAZDA CX-30" and "MAZDA2 Hybrid" increased, sales volume decreased by 3.4% from the previous fiscal year to 174 k units due to lower sales of the "CX-60", "CX-5", and "MAZDA6", among others.
rows.smartcat_en: Although sales of the MAZDA CX-30 and MAZDA2 Hybrid increased, sales of the CX-60, CX-5 and MAZDA6 decreased by 3.4% year on year to 174 thousand units.
rows.deepl_en: Although sales of the “MAZDA CX-30” and “MAZDA2 Hybrid” increased, sales of the “CX-60,” “CX-5,” and “MAZDA6,” among others, declined, resulting in a 3.4% year-over-year decrease to 174,000 units.
rows.nani_en: Although sales of the "MAZDA CX-30" and "MAZDA2 Hybrid" increased, sales of the "CX-60", "CX-5", and "MAZDA6" decreased, resulting in a 3.4% year-on-year decrease to 174 thousand units.
rows.llm_en: Although sales of the MAZDA CX-30 and MAZDA2 Hybrid increased, lower sales of models such as the CX-60, CX-5 and MAZDA6 brought volume down 3.4% year on year to 174 thousand units.

rows.ja: 当連結会計年度末の総資産は、前連結会計年度末より2,983億円増加し、4兆901億円となり、負債合計は、前連    結会計年度末より2,457億円増加し、2兆2,801億円となりました。
rows.reference_en: As of March 31, 2025, total assets increased ¥298.3 billion from the end of the previous fiscal year, to ¥4,090.1 billion.     Total liabilities increased ¥245.7 billion from the end of the previous fiscal year to ¥2,280.1 billion.
rows.yakulingo_en: Total assets at the end of the current consolidated fiscal year increased by 2,983 oku from the end of the previous consolidated fiscal year to 40,901 oku, while total liabilities increased by 2,457 oku from the end of the previous consolidated fiscal year to 22,801 oku.
rows.smartcat_en: Total assets increased by ¥298.3 billion from the end of the previous fiscal year to ¥4,901 billion, and total liabilities increased by ¥245.7 billion from the end of the previous fiscal year to ¥2,280.1 billion.
rows.deepl_en: Total assets at the end of the current fiscal year increased by 298.3 billion yen from the end of the previous fiscal year to 4.0901 trillion yen, while total liabilities increased by 245.7 billion yen from the end of the previous fiscal year to 2.2801 trillion yen.
rows.nani_en: Total assets at the end of the current consolidated fiscal year increased by 298.3 billion yen from the end of the previous consolidated fiscal year to 4,090.1 billion yen, and total liabilities increased by 245.7 billion yen from the end of the previous consolidated fiscal year to 2,280.1 billion yen.
rows.llm_en: Total assets at the end of the fiscal year under review increased ¥298.3 billion from the end of the previous fiscal year to ¥4,090.1 billion, while total liabilities increased ¥245.7 billion from the end of the previous fiscal year to ¥2,280.1 billion.

rows.ja: 純資産は、親会社株主に帰属する当期純利益1,141億円等により、前連結会計年度末より527億円増加し、    1兆8,100億円となりました。自己資本比率は、前連結会計年度末より2.0ポイント減少し、43.8％(劣後特約付ローンの資本性考慮後44.7％)となりました。
rows.reference_en: Net assets as of March 31, 2025 increased ¥52.7 billion from the end of the previous fiscal year to ¥1,810.0 billion,     reflecting net income attributable to owners of the parent of ¥114.1 billion and others. Equity ratio decreased 2.0     percentage points from the end of the previous fiscal year to 43.8% (Percentage after consideration of the equity credit     attributes of the subordinated loan was 44.7%).
rows.yakulingo_en: Net assets increased by 527 oku from the end of the previous consolidated fiscal year, due to factors including profit attributable to owners of the parent of 1,141 oku, and amounted to 18,100 oku. The equity ratio decreased by 2.0 percentage points from the end of the previous consolidated fiscal year to 43.8% (or 44.7% after considering the equity characteristics of subordinated loans with special subordinated clauses).
rows.smartcat_en: Net assets increased by ¥114.1 billion, including net income attributable to owners of parent, to ¥52.7 billion from the end of the previous fiscal year to ¥1,810.0 billion. The equity ratio decreased by 2.0 percentage points from the end of the previous fiscal year to 43.8% (44.7% after consideration of the equity of subordinated loans).
rows.deepl_en: Net assets increased by 52.7 billion yen from the end of the previous fiscal year to 1.81 trillion yen, driven by factors including net income attributable to owners of the parent of 114.1 billion yen. The equity ratio decreased by 2.0 percentage points from the end of the previous fiscal year to 43.8% (44.7% after taking into account the equity nature of subordinated loans).
rows.nani_en: Net assets increased by 52.7 billion yen from the end of the previous consolidated fiscal year to 1,810.0 billion yen, due to factors such as 114.1 billion yen in net income attributable to owners of the parent. The equity ratio decreased by 2.0 percentage points from the end of the previous consolidated fiscal year to 43.8% (44.7% after taking into consideration the equity characteristics of subordinated loans).
rows.llm_en: Net assets increased ¥52.7 billion from the end of the previous fiscal year to ¥1,810.0 billion, mainly reflecting profit attributable to owners of the parent of ¥114.1 billion. The equity ratio fell 2.0 percentage points from the end of the previous fiscal year to 43.8% (44.7% after taking into account the equity credit attributed to subordinated loans).
